name: trailcraft
description: Scent-work training record: dual-track GPS, 3D terrain, scent drift.

scripts.test: node test/geo.test.mjs && node test/store.test.mjs && node test/sync.test.mjs && node test/field.test.mjs && node test/gesture.test.mjs && node test/team.test.mjs && node test/design.test.mjs && node test/card.test.mjs && node test/share.test.mjs && node test/pdf.test.mjs && node test/coach.test.mjs && node test/colours.test.mjs && node test/ground.test.mjs && node test/debrief.test.mjs && node test/call.test.mjs && node test/walls.test.mjs && node test/wiring.test.mjs && node test/build.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm test && git push origin main && git push -f origin `git subtree split --prefix public HEAD`:refs/heads/gh-pages
scripts.build:sim: npx cap sync ios && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/derived -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/spm CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:phone: npx cap sync ios && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination "id=${PHONE:-58FC6D09-76EE-566A-B921-929D8144F53E}" -derivedDataPath build/derived-device -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/spm -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=D2XXMB3G43 CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic build && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun devicectl device install app --device "${PHONE:-58FC6D09-76EE-566A-B921-929D8144F53E}" build/derived-device/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app
